answer: Because the anchor release is recorded with every signature, the fable audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the relic graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 5 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
